revision: LQR-default predictive gate v2; frozen existing policies; no new training
selection: Choose lowest development gated-residual mean failure-penalized RMSE subject to survival >= LQR and nominal RMSE <= 1.02*LQR. If none qualifies, select minimum RMSE with explicit development rejection; do not label deployment-ready. Apply same chosen gate to full-command ablation.
primary_test: Per-scenario paired gated_residual minus LQR seed-mean penalized RMSE. Report all six regions, sample SD and descriptive 95% t intervals (df=4); no multiplicity-adjusted significance claim. Clear region advantage requires >=5% mean reduction, all five seed differences negative and no survival decrease. Nominal preservation requires <=2% mean RMSE increase and no survival decrease.
failure: abs true lateral error >2.5 m or abs heading error >0.6 rad or nonfinite state; fill unexecuted tail with 2.5 m for penalized RMSE
limitations: New noise seeds only; reused geometries and trained seeds. Predictor is nominal linear, not oracle mismatch model. Simulator scheduling, no hard-real-time claim. This revision is surrogate-only pending independent native Webots transfer. Specification unchanged; intentional architecture deviation.
